plan.processStrategy: fresh process per pair, same process and snapshot for OFF/ON
plan.modeOrder: seeded shuffle, exactly 5 OFF_ON and 5 ON_OFF per load
plan.arrival: fixed 80-ms burst offsets; foreground 20+2*position ms; identical hashed schedule per pair
plan.admission: all foreground requests offer a shadow; unchanged production sample=1 and capacity=4; capacity skips retained
plan.connection: same keepAlive agent maxSockets=8 and fixture server through pair; internal fetch unchanged; warmup both modes
plan.interpreterShadow: true in both modes; same fixture interpreter, no model calls
plan.outlierPolicy: no exclusions for latency; only infrastructure failure INVALID_TRIAL; no replacement trials
